Description: Unique identifier for each Amazon product listing
Business Relevance: Primary key; used for deduplication, joins, and tracking products across tables

Description: Full product title as listed on Amazon
Sample Values: Wayona Nylon Braided USB Cable, boAt Deuce USB 300
Business Relevance: Enables product search, NLP analysis, brand extraction

Description: Hierarchical product category separated by | pipe characters
Business Relevance: Segmentation analysis, category-level performance comparisons

Description: Human-readable version of category with > separators (engineered)
Business Relevance: Better readability for reporting and dashboards

Description: Top-level product category extracted from category hierarchy (engineered)
Business Relevance: High-level segmentation, category trend analysis

Description: Selling price of the product in Indian Rupees (₹) after discount
Business Relevance: Revenue modelling, price elasticity analysis, customer segmentation

Description: Original MRP of the product in Indian Rupees (₹) before discount
Business Relevance: Baseline for discount calculation, perceived value analysis

Description: Percentage discount offered on the product
Business Relevance: Promotional strategy analysis, identifying heavily discounted products

Description: Discount % computed from actual_price and discounted_price as validation (engineered)
Business Relevance: Data quality check — flags rows where stated discount doesn't match computed value

Description: Absolute savings in ₹ = actual_price - discounted_price (engineered)
Business Relevance: Customer value perception, promotional impact quantification

Description: Categorical band of discount level (engineered)
Business Relevance: Quick segmentation for marketing tiers — Low / Moderate / High / Very High / Extreme

Description: Price category of the discounted product (engineered)
Business Relevance: Audience targeting — Budget / Mid-range / Premium / Luxury

Description: Average customer star rating (out of 5)
Business Relevance: Product quality proxy, recommendation engine input, seller performance

Description: Total number of customer ratings received
Business Relevance: Popularity and social proof indicator, statistical reliability of rating

Description: Boolean flag — True if rating >= 4.0 (engineered)
Business Relevance: Filter for high-quality products, quick reporting segmentation

Description: Boolean flag — True if rating_count exceeds 75th percentile (engineered)
Business Relevance: Identifies viral/bestseller products for marketing focus

Description: Composite score = rating × log(rating_count + 1) (engineered)
Business Relevance: Balances quality and popularity; useful for product ranking and recommendation scoring

Description: Pipe-separated bullet-point product description from the listing
Business Relevance: Feature extraction, NLP, product classification, search optimisation

Description: Pipe-separated list of Amazon user IDs who reviewed the product
Business Relevance: Can be split to get individual reviewers; useful for reviewer behaviour analysis

Description: Pipe-separated list of reviewer display names
Business Relevance: Reviewer demographics (informal), sentiment analysis attribution

Description: Pipe-separated list of unique review IDs on Amazon
Business Relevance: Review-level joins, tracking review authenticity, deduplication

Description: Pipe-separated short review titles submitted by customers
Business Relevance: Quick sentiment tagging, keyword analysis, summary generation

Description: Pipe-separated full review texts from customers
Sample Values: Charging is really fast and good product...
Business Relevance: Rich NLP source — sentiment analysis, topic modelling, fake review detection

Description: URL to the product image hosted on Amazon CDN
Business Relevance: Used in UI/dashboards, visual product search, image-based ML models

Description: URL to the Amazon product detail page
Business Relevance: Direct product lookup, web scraping pipeline anchor, affiliate tracking
